sign: A brass arm of the Great Orrery fell here. The planet it held is still missing.
climber: Agathe: I'm looking for the missing planet. Whoever finds it gets paid by three families. Whoever keeps it gets buried by four.
climber_intro: Agathe: You're after the planet too. Don't lie, everyone is.
climber_defeat: Agathe: Keep looking. Up, not down.
